q1.question: What are "Data Credits"?
q1.answer:
Data Credits are the currency you use to conduct research on our platform. They are consumed in the following ways:
1. Data Usage: 1 credit is used for each row of data loaded on our "Insights" or "Analysis" pages.
2. Exporting Data: 1 credit is used for each row of data exported to a CSV or Excel file.
3. No Charge: Social Listening queries do not consume Data Credits.
Please note: Credits reset at the beginning of your billing cycle each month. Unused credits do not roll over.

faqs.q: How much does a listing cost? Is it one-time or recurring?
faqs.a: It is a one-time payment. There is no subscription.

faqs.q: How soon will my tool go live?
faqs.a: Paid submissions skip the queue and are usually published within 48 hours.

faqs.q: Does my listing expire?
faqs.a: No. Once approved, your listing stays in the directory permanently.

faqs.q: How can I get more views?
faqs.a: Combine your listing with an ad campaign or a guest post for extra exposure.

faqs.q: Why was my tool not listed?
faqs.a: We reject tools that are unreachable, not AI-related, or that violate our content policy. You will be notified and refunded.

faqs.q: Do you guarantee traffic or sales?
faqs.a: No. We guarantee the listing and its placement, not specific traffic or revenue outcomes.

faqs.q: What is your refund policy?
faqs.a: If your tool is rejected, you get a full refund. Published listings are non-refundable.

faqs.q: Do you work with agencies?
faqs.a: Yes — contact us for bulk submissions.

points: Shown in the "Just Launched" block on the home page.

types.title: Featured placement
points: Pinned slots on home, latest, most used, most saved, search results and category pages.
Higher remaining balance ranks higher — top up anytime to climb.
Sponsor bar at the top of most pages, rotated between advertisers.
Also shown on blog, comparison and alternatives pages.
Every ad click goes straight to your website.

advertise.reportNote: You get a detailed report for every campaign. You can also track results with Google Analytics or any analytics tool.

faqs.q: How does advertising work?
faqs.a: Pick a tool and a click package. Once paid, your ads start rotating across the site until the purchased clicks are delivered.

faqs.q: Can I buy clicks more than once?
faqs.a: Yes. New purchases are added to your balance, which also raises your featured ranking.

faqs.q: I have more budget and want more customers. What should I do?
faqs.a: Buy a larger package or contact us for a custom campaign with guest posts and social promotion.

faqs.q: Can I target specific countries or languages?
faqs.a: Not at the moment. Targeting is automatic.

faqs.q: Can I choose where my ads appear?
faqs.a: No. Placements are chosen automatically to deliver your clicks as fast as possible.

guestPost.faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions – Guest Post / Link Insert

faqs.q: How do I order a guest post?
faqs.a: Buy at least 2 credits, then submit your article from your dashboard. Our editors review it before publishing.

faqs.q: How do I order a link insert?
faqs.a: Buy 1 credit per link, then send us the target URL, anchor text and the article you want it placed in (or let us pick one).

faqs.q: What does the publishing process look like?
faqs.a: Purchase credits → submit content or link details → editorial review → publication. You get the live URL by email.

faqs.q: Are there content guidelines for guest posts?
faqs.a: Articles should be original, AI-related, useful to readers and free of spammy or adult links. We may request edits.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund for unused credits?
faqs.a: Yes. Contact support and unused credits will be refunded to the original payment method.

faqs.q: What do guest posts and link inserts do for me?
faqs.a: They put your product in front of an AI-focused audience and give you a permanent dofollow backlink.

faqs.q: Is there a bulk discount?
faqs.a: Yes — any order above {min} credits is automatically discounted by {percent}%.

faqs.q: Do you work with agencies?
faqs.a: Yes. Agencies managing multiple clients can contact us for custom arrangements.

update.seoDesc: Update the details of your tool listed on {site}.
update.panelTitle: Pay first, then submit your changes
notes: After payment you get a form where you submit the changes you need.
Paste the new content into the matching fields — name, category, intro, description, usage, features, use cases, pricing or FAQs.
Website URLs cannot be changed. If you moved to a new domain, set up a redirect from the old one.
Every update is reviewed manually before going live. If it is rejected, you are refunded automatically.
Each payment covers one update. Please double-check your content before submitting.

faqs.q: How much does an update cost?
faqs.a: A flat one-time fee per update, shown above.

faqs.q: How does the update process work?
faqs.a: Pay → fill in the update form → our team reviews → changes go live.

faqs.q: Do I have to write the new content myself?
faqs.a: Yes. If you do not submit new content, nothing is changed and you can request a refund.

faqs.q: Which details can I change?
faqs.a: Everything in the list above except the website URL.
